rewrites.//: Each public route is served its own pre-rendered HTML (written by scripts/build-seo.js) so a crawler reads that page's real title, description, canonical and JSON-LD instead of the SPA's shared shell. Every one of these files still boots the same bundle, so navigation is unchanged. They MUST come before the catch-all below, which would otherwise swallow them.
Everything else that isn't an API call is client-side routing.

headers.//: Private areas are behind auth already, but this keeps them out of the index even if a URL leaks into a link somewhere. Belt and braces with the runtime noindex tag in src/shared/seo.js.
